title: Repeat Buyer Pricing for Summit Top-Up Miles
content:
**Rule.** In the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, the repeat-buyer treatment sets the net price per thousand of a top-up purchase from the tier price per thousand, before any amount per thousand is taken off it. It follows the purchase entries posted on the membership in the last twelve months.

- 2 or more purchase entries: the net price per thousand is set at the tier price per thousand less a flat 3 USD, with no multiplying.
- Exactly 1 purchase entry: the net price per thousand is set at the tier price per thousand multiplied by 0.95, rounded to the cent.
- None: the net price per thousand is kept at the tier price per thousand.

A purchase entry counts when its posting date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day of the new purchase.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Tier price per 1000 miles (USD) | Purchase entries in the last twelve months | Net price per 1000 set by this rule (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 35 | 2 | 32 |
| 35 | 1 | 33.25 |
| 30 | 1 | 28.50 |
| 28 | 1 | 26.60 |
| 28 | 0 | 28 |
